report.title: {Items.Count} assignment {Plural(Items.Count, 'filter is', 'filters are')} not used by any assignment

messages.businessImpact: Filters written and never applied, which usually means an intended targeting change was started and left unfinished.
remediation: Apply the filters where they were meant to go, or delete them.
messages.cannotSee: The filter list and twelve supported assignable workloads must all be collected; if any required area is unavailable this check skips instead of calling a referenced filter unused. A filter deliberately retained for a future change looks the same as one forgotten.
